name: University of Auckland
feeMethod: Charges per course at rates that differ by faculty, so the calculator uses Auckland's estimated fee for a full-time 120-point year, taking the top where a degree's fee is a range.
description: The University of Auckland is a public research university in Auckland, founded in 1883. With over 40,000 students it is New Zealand's largest university.
whyIncluded: Its MB ChB is on the Singapore Medical Council's list of registrable basic medical qualifications and its LLB is on the Singapore Institute of Legal Education's list of approved overseas universities (graduates in the top 70% of their cohort).

livingCosts.summary: Living costs listed by the university's Business School for a 12-month year: rent, groceries, a bus pass, phone and gym. Entertainment is not included.
livingCosts.notes: University of Auckland Business School 'Living costs' list (the main auckland.ac.nz cost-of-living page gives no full estimate; the page gives no year, 2026 is the year it was read), range midpoints. Housing: rent $200-$300/wk x 52/12. Food: groceries $100-$150/wk x 52/12. Transport: monthly bus pass $200-$250. Personal: phone plan $30-$40/month + gym membership $319/yr / 12; excludes entertainment (the university's accommodation page suggests ~$70/wk for entertainment and gym). The page's headline is NZ$20,000-$25,000 a year (NZ$400-$450/wk) for accommodation, food and transport.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts

programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students, for a full-time year. Performance and science-based courses cost more. Student services fee included. Not fixed.
programmes.notes: 2026 international fee for a full-time BA year from the BA programme page (and the 2026 Programme List): 'International students NZ$40,225 – $48,133'; the upper end is used (from 2026-10-15 at Kumar's request; it is the 'performance and science-based courses' figure, standard arts courses cost NZ$40,225). Indicative; inclusive of 15% GST. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024 and 2025 = upper end of the same page's range in those years, read from Common Crawl captures (CC-MAIN-2023-50, 5 Dec 2023: '2024 fees ... International students NZ$36,836 – $44,078'; CC-MAIN-2024-46, 3 Nov 2024: '2025 fees ... NZ$38,310 – $45,841'), with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Laws
programmes.feeBasis: Auckland's 2026 estimated LLB fee of NZ$47,218 a year (8 law courses at NZ$5,902.20); year 1 mixes in another degree's courses and may be up to about 9% lower.
programmes.feeChoice: Charged per course, so the law course rate for a full-time year is used for every year, though year 1 may cost a little less.
programmes.summary: University's estimated yearly tuition for international students for a full-time year of law. Year 1 mixes 45 law points with 75 from another degree, so it is about 9% lower with Arts courses and about the same with Science or Commerce.
programmes.notes: 2026 estimated international fee for 120 points (8 x 15-point LAW course at NZ$5,902.20; 480 points over 4 years). LLB Part I is 45 points of law plus 75 points from another degree, so the first year is a little lower. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120 (cssf page). 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point LAW course fee from that year's international Law fee schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point. Later-year check 2026-10-08: 2026 Law international schedule: Part I courses (LAW 121G, 131, 141) and 200 to 400-level LAW courses all NZ$5,902.20 per 15 points, so Parts II to IV = 8 x 5,902.20 = NZ$47,217.60. Part I is 45 law points (NZ$17,706.60) plus 75 points of another degree: about NZ$42,847 with Arts (5 x 5,028.15), NZ$47,220 with Science, NZ$47,790 with Commerce. The university publishes one LLB figure (NZ$47,218) and no Part I figure, so year 1 is kept at the published rate rather than guessing the partner degree. 2027 schedules not yet published.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery (MB ChB)
programmes.feeBasis: Year 1 uses Auckland's 2026 estimated fee of NZ$42,818 for the shared first year; years 2-6 use the medical programme rate of about NZ$86,561 a year (year 3 about NZ$75,740).
programmes.feeChoice: The shared first year and the medical programme years have their own rates, each used for its own years.
programmes.summary: At 2026 rates, year 1 costs about NZ$42,800 and years 2 to 6 about NZ$86,561 a year (year 3 is 105 points, about NZ$75,740). Fees are set each year and are not fixed for your intake. Student services fee included.
programmes.notes: First-year rate: the 2026 estimated international fee for the Year 1 (overlapping BHSc / Biomedical Science year, 120 points at NZ$5,352.30 per 15-point course), which the programme list quotes for MB ChB Year 1. Years 2 to 6 are NZ$86,561 a year (MBChB Part II-VI, 2 x 60-point halves at NZ$43,280.40 each; Part III is 105 points, NZ$75,740.70), so the six-year total is about NZ$475,600. 720 points over 6 years. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 120. 2024/2025 = 8 x 15-point Year 1 course fee (MEDSCI 142 / POPLHLTH) from that year's international Medical and Health Sciences schedule, with SSF NZ$8.88 / NZ$9.24 per point; MBChB Part II was NZ$83,232 in 2024 and NZ$86,560.80 in 2025. laterYears added 2026-10-08 from the figures above; annualTuition is now the year-1 figure. Second look 2026-10-14: cohortLocked kept false; the summary quoted a six-year total (NZ$465,000-475,600) as if fixed, so it now gives the per-year rates 'at 2026 rates' and says fees are set each year. The 2026 Programme List (https://www.auckland.ac.nz/assets/study/international-students/agent-resources/publications/Programme-List-2026-WEB.pdf, read 2026-10-14) labels the figures 'estimated tuition fees for 2026' and 'a general guide only and ... subject to alteration'; nothing states that the fee is fixed for the cohort.

programmes.name: Master of Professional Accounting
programmes.feeBasis: Auckland's 2026 international fee schedule: 12 courses at NZ$6,263.10 each (NZ$75,157.20 for 180 points), divided by the 1.25-year programme. Assumes the Managing People course is BUSMGT 711; if BUSMAN 701, NZ$303.75 less.
programmes.feeChoice: The fees for all 12 courses are added up and spread evenly over the degree's 1.25 years.
programmes.summary: Estimated yearly tuition for international students on the 15-month, 180-point course, spread over 1.25 years, including 15% GST. Student services fee is included; insurance and living costs are extra.
programmes.notes: International fee schedule 'Tuition fees 2026 - International students: Business and Economics': the 12 x 15-point courses of the MProfAcctg (BUSACT 701-705, 731/732/734 and BUSMGT core courses) are all NZ$6,263.10 each, so 12 x 6,263.10 = 75,157.20 for 180 points over the 15-month programme (page: https://www.auckland.ac.nz/en/study/study-options/find-a-study-option/master-of-professional-accounting-mprofacctg.html shows no fee, only the schedule does); divided by durationYears 1.25 = 60,125.76. Assumption: the 'Managing People and Organisations' course is BUSMGT 711 (6,263.10); if it is BUSMAN 701 (5,959.35) the total is NZ$303.75 lower. Compulsory = Student Services Fee NZ$9.44/point x 180 = 1,699.20 over the programme, /1.25 = 1,359.36 (schedule says it 'may be charged'). History rows use the same method: 2025 schedule (Website_Fees_BE_International.pdf) courses 5,964.90 x 12 = 71,578.80, SSF 9.24/pt; 2024 schedule (Website_Fees_B&E_International.pdf) courses 5,735.55 x 12 = 68,826.60, SSF 8.88/pt. All include 15% GST. The 2024/2025 programme structure (15 months, 180 points) was assumed unchanged. Fees reviewed annually, not cohort locked.
